finding.title: The code does not check if the `source_code` string is within the expected bounds when parsing.
The code does not check if `int_type` or `int_type->name` is `NULL` before attempting to free them.
The code does not handle errors from `create_parser`, `parse_constrained_int_type`, or other functions that might fail.

scan_patch.message: Does not handle strings that are not \0-terminated; if given one it may perform an over-read (it could cause a crash if unprotected) (CWE-126).
